references.text: The spies' report on the great and fortified cities in Canaan, which caused fear among the Israelites
The spies describe the people of the land as stronger than the Israelites and mention the descendants of Anak (the Anakim)
The people's reaction to the spies' report - they lost heart and wanted to return to Egypt
Moses repeats the description of the great cities with walls reaching up to heaven and the Anakim
Caleb asks for the land of the Anakim and mentions their large and fortified cities
Joshua destroyed the Anakim from the hill country in Israel
Reference to how the spies made the people's hearts melt when they saw the land
The book of Hebrews explains that the Israelites could not enter the land because of unbelief
